notes: OpenBoxes is an open-source inventory and supply-chain management system for health commodities, built on Grails; its HTTP API lives under the application context path (normally /openboxes) at /api and is authenticated with a JSESSIONID cookie from POST /api/login. No machine spec exists anywhere (see attempts), so this document is hand-authored. 'Full' here means both halves of the surface: every endpoint in the vendor's API guide, modelled from its example responses with named schemas, plus every one of the 209 /api URL mappings in UrlMappings.groovy on the develop branch, which is the vendor's own authoritative route table and covers the ~200 endpoints the React UI uses that the guide never documents. Undocumented routes are carried with their real path, methods and controller action but an unconstrained application/json response schema and a description saying the shape is not documented - no fields were invented for them. Where the 2018-era guide and the current source disagree, the source wins and the guide is treated as stale: GET /api/products returns { data, totalCount } (not the bare array the guide shows), POST /api/products answers 200 with a { product } wrapper rather than the usual { data } envelope, and the Generic API create returns 201 while delete returns 204. Required-ness is deliberately not asserted on the resource schemas, because the same schemas describe request bodies and embedded partial references. The openboxes adaptor exposes only generic get/post/request helpers (ast.json confirms: no named operations, so there is no fixed endpoint list to cross-check); the whole spec is therefore the reachable surface. Still unknown: response shapes for the undocumented routes, the exact query-parameter sets on most of them, and per-deployment context paths other than /openboxes.
